## Submission Checklist

Before submitting to any list:

- [ ] Repo has a clear description on GitHub
- [ ] README.md is complete and well-formatted
- [ ] LICENSE file is present (MIT)
- [ ] At least 10+ real stars (some lists require this)
- [ ] CI badge shows passing
- [ ] Check the list's CONTRIBUTING.md for alphabetical ordering requirements
- [ ] Fork the awesome list, add entry, open PR with the template above
